y_axis: Reported official MNIST test accuracy, percent
scope: Selected primary-source results, not an exhaustive benchmark. External results were not independently rerun. Markers distinguish custom inference code plus model data from model/weight payload only; all runtime and packaging contracts are source-specific.
unit_convention: Exact byte or bit figures retained. Rounded kB/KB figures plotted at 1000 bytes per kB; these positions are approximate, not exact file measurements.
